meta.description: Coventry movers for family houses: full home moves with every piece wrapped and strapped, packing on request and hourly local billing. Free quote.

overview: A Coventry family house move usually means a full truck, a garage to empty and a day that runs from morning to evening. We size the crew for that from the start.
Wrapping, loading order and the drive are all part of the quote.
sellingPoints: Full house moves with a matched crew
Packing by the room on request
hero.ctaLabel: Get a Coventry House Move Quote

servicesBlock.intro: This page is written for whole-house residential moves. Packing, storage while a sale closes and long distance moves for families heading out of state are also available, along with piano and furniture-only jobs. If the house has a basement or attic full of stored things, count those spaces when you list what's moving, because they often take longer to clear than the bedrooms.

whyChoose.h2: How We Run a Coventry Family Move

cards.title: Crew Sized to the House
cards.text: Before the date is set, the manager goes over the room count and big items to decide how many movers to send. Too few people makes a long day longer.

cards.title: Wrapped Room by Room
cards.text: Every piece of furniture is wrapped before it leaves its room. Mattresses, tables and dressers each get their own protection.

cards.title: Strapped for the Drive
cards.text: Once everything is loaded, the crew straps the furniture in place. Heavy pieces go in first and boxes fill the space around them.

cards.title: Materials Inside the Rate
cards.text: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate. Packing boxes are charged separately, per item.

faqHeading: What Coventry Families Ask Before Moving Day

faq.q: How many movers will you send for a Coventry house?
faq.a: That depends on the size of the house and what's in it. The manager sets the crew size from your inventory, stairs and access before the date is booked.

faq.q: How long does a full house move in Coventry take?
faq.a: Most of the time goes into loading and unloading, plus travel from our yard. Your quote gives an estimate of hours once the manager has your inventory.

faq.q: Do you empty garages, sheds and basements too?
faq.a: Yes. Put them on your inventory, especially tools, bikes and outdoor furniture, so the truck has room for everything.

faq.q: Can you pack our kitchen and leave the rest to us?
faq.a: Yes. You can hand us any single room. Boxes and supplies are charged per item for what the crew uses.

faq.q: What if our Coventry closing date gets pushed?
faq.a: Your belongings can go into storage until the new house is ready. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faqClosing: Our FAQ page has more on travel time, minimums and payment.

closing.body: Send the room count, the big items and both addresses. A manager will size the crew and give you the price before anything is booked.
